## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Security and privacy checklist

- [ ] No credentials, tokens, private keys, personal data, or health information are committed.
- [ ] Authentication and tenant authorization are enforced server-side where required.
- [ ] Input validation, error handling, and audit logging were considered.
- [ ] Dependencies are necessary and vulnerability checks pass.
- [ ] Tests cover security-relevant behavior and failure paths.
- [ ] No workflow grants unnecessary write permissions or exposes secrets to untrusted code.
- [ ] Documentation and operational runbooks are updated.
- [ ] Changes do not enable Claude or any external provider by default.
- [ ] Any change involving production, infrastructure, identity, or data retention has been reviewed explicitly.

## Verification

List tests, scanners, and manual checks performed.

## Risk / rollback

Describe the security impact, deployment requirements, and rollback plan.
